note: Only sources this lane READ. A repo row names the file, the line and a text that must be on that line (idempiere = the local legacy source, read from disk; bim-ootb = origin/main); a web row names the URL and the copy fetched into out/prior/ (2026-11-16) and a text that must be in that copy. guard.js check P fails a row whose text is not there. Nothing from memory. A row with `lang` is shown only in the cut whose language beat is that language. *_zh = the Mandarin cut's words (translated by the build session).
